title: Normal Saline Vrs Balanced i.v. Fluids in Neurosurgery
brief_summary: The purpose of this study was to investigate whether the balanced fluids therapy change plasma osmolality in neurosurgical procedures due to brain tumors, meningeomas and arterio-venous malformation.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with brain tumor, meningeomas and vascular malformation.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with signs of elevated intracranial pressure; History of kidney disease, History of heart disease
study_population: Patients who underwent neurosurgical procedure because of brain tumor, meningeoma and vascular malformation. And without signs of elevated intracranial pressure and any history of kidney or heart disease.
